_note: English energy cards. image is used in sentences ("You are the Oak"); measure is the English article that goes before image ("an Oak"); symbol is the one-word badge.

甲.intro: Like a great oak: once you know your direction, you keep growing toward it, and people like to lean on you.
甲.strong: Deep roots and full branches. You know your mind — just leave some room for others too.
甲.weak: A young tree still putting down roots. Find the right soil and sunlight and you grow fast.

乙.intro: Like a flowering vine: you rise with the moment and get along with almost anyone.
乙.strong: Lush and well-connected. Just be clear about which favors are yours to do.
乙.weak: You need a wall to climb. Find people you can count on and you'll bloom.

丙.intro: Like the sun: wherever you go, the room gets brighter.
丙.strong: Plenty of shine. Dial it down now and then so no one gets sunburned.
丙.weak: A winter sun: warm, but pace yourself. Don't give all your heat away at once.

丁.intro: Like a candle: never loud, but you light up the people around you.
丁.strong: A strong flame and sharp focus. Careful not to burn through yourself too fast.
丁.weak: A flame that needs shelter from the wind. With the right people around you, your light holds steady.

戊.intro: Like a mountain: solid and always there. People trust you.
戊.strong: Rock solid and reliable, though it can tip into stubborn. A little movement does you good.
戊.weak: A mountain still taking shape. Build up slowly, skip the big leaps, and you'll only get steadier.

己.intro: Like a field: you quietly help everything grow, and your effort shows up as a real harvest.
己.strong: Rich soil that can carry a lot. Just don't take everything onto your own shoulders.
己.weak: A field that needs watering. Feed yourself first and the harvest will come.

庚.intro: Like a sword: clean and quick to act. When you promise something, it gets done.
庚.strong: A sharp edge and fast moves. Leave a little room when you speak.
庚.weak: A blade still being forged. The more you're tested, the brighter your edge.

辛.intro: Like a jewel: you notice the details and like to do things beautifully.
辛.strong: Dazzling, with high standards. Just don't be too hard on yourself.
辛.weak: A gem waiting to be polished. Find a place that values you and you'll shine.

壬.intro: Like the ocean: open-hearted, full of ideas, and not one for being boxed in.
壬.strong: A mighty tide of ideas. Pick one and see it all the way through.
壬.weak: Rivers still flowing together. Take in more, connect more, and you'll become the sea.

癸.intro: Like soft rain: quiet and perceptive, often the first to sense how others feel.
癸.strong: Plenty of rain and deep feeling. You don't have to carry everyone's emotions.
癸.weak: A light drizzle waiting for clouds to gather. Spend time with people and the inspiration flows.
